propositions: recheck-review must accept bugfix-size-attestation blocks when the ticket carries a current plan-review attestation that buckets as accepted, rather than refusing all current-revision finding states

the acceptance condition must verify exactly one blocking finding exists (header count = 1) and that finding is bugfix-size-attestation, to avoid false acceptance when findings are truncated in the vote message

the ticket id must be resolved from the commit-message trailer via ticket_for_commit_message, not parsed from the finding detail text, to sidestep 240-char clipping and ensure consistency with the gate's own ticket resolution

an attestation verdict of stale-material, mismatch, invalid, or any FLAG_VERDICTS entry must refuse re-review, preventing a contributor from attesting then editing the plan to unlock a stale attestation
infra verdicts (unavailable/error) must not auto-accept via this arm, and any block containing bugfix-size-attestation plus other blocking findings must still refuse

eligibility must read only bot vote message and ticket store (no requesting-comment inputs), write no vote label, and reuse the gate's classify_plan_review_attestation and bucket_for_verdict rather than reimplementing attestation logic
